proposals.before: Fan Hong, courtesy name Miqqing, came from Huyang in Nanyang and was Emperor Guangwu's uncle by marriage.
proposals.after: Fan Hong, courtesy name Miqing, came from Huyang in Nanyang and was Emperor Guangwu's maternal uncle.
proposals.reason: 靡卿 is Miqing (not Miqqing); 舅 denotes maternal uncle, not uncle by marriage.

proposals.before: Fan Hong, courtesy name Miqqing, was a man of Huyang in Nanyang; he was Shizu's maternal uncle.
proposals.after: Fan Hong, courtesy name Miqing, was a man of Huyang in Nanyang; he was Shizu's maternal uncle.
proposals.reason: 靡卿 romanization should be Miqing, not Miqqing.

proposals.before: The county praised his beauty and pushed him to be one of the three elders.
proposals.after: The county praised his excellence and pushed him to be one of the three elders.
proposals.reason: 稱美 here means praise for virtue/excellence, not physical beauty.

proposals.before: Creditors who heard were all ashamed and vied to go repay; his sons followed the command and to the end refused to accept.
proposals.after: Debtors who heard were all ashamed and vied to go repay; his sons followed the command and to the end refused to accept.
proposals.reason: 責家 are debtors owing money, not creditors.

decisions.reason: 字靡卿 is Miqing (靡+卿), not Miqqing; 世祖之舅 means Shizu's maternal uncle, not uncle by marriage. The proposed idiomatic corrects both errors accurately.
字靡卿 romanizes as Miqing; the literal's Miqqing is a spelling error, and the proposed fix is exact.
縣中稱美 praises Chong's excellence/virtue that led to being named 三老, not physical beauty; replacing beauty with excellence matches the Chinese.
After Chong ordered the loan contracts burned (假貸……焚削文契), 責家 who rush to 償之 are the debtors who owe repayment, not creditors; Creditors is inverted.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 責家聞者皆慚，爭往償之
